repos_data.description: :tv: A free and simple to use video player made with Haskell.
Open-source Tax Guides for AI agents, reviewed by named CPAs/CAs/EAs. 1,000+ Guides across 190+ jurisdictions. MCP server included. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor.

Turns Indian GST tax invoices into government INV-01 JSON. Tells you exactly what it couldn't read, and never invents a value to fill a gap. MCP server with OCR, deterministic extraction, and a grounded LLM stage.
